terms.gloss: powerless, weak; with a genitive, not master of (īrae, suī); hence unbridled, headstrong, violent
evidence: Cic. Fin. 1.52: neque hominī īnfantī aut impotentī injūstē facta condūcunt (Lewis & Short)
Liv. 9.14.5: gēns impotēns rērum suārum (Lewis & Short)

phrases.latin: neque hominī īnfantī aut impotentī injūstē facta condūcunt
phrases.english: nor do unjust deeds profit a man who lacks eloquence or power
a people not master of its own affairs
